name.description: Unique name for the hunt group.

phoneNumber.description: Primary phone number of the hunt group. Either phone number or extension are required.

extension.description: Primary phone extension of the hunt group. Either phone number or extension are required.

firstName.description: First name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this hunt group. Defaults to `.`. This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

lastName.description: Last name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this hunt group. Defaults to the phone number if set, otherwise defaults to call group name. This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

timeZone.description: Time zone for the hunt group.

callPolicies.description: Policy controlling how calls are routed to agents.

agents.description: People, workspaces and virtual lines that are eligible to  receive calls.

enabled.description: Whether or not the hunt group is enabled.

huntGroupCallerIdForOutgoingCallsEnabled.description: Enable the hunt group to be used as the caller ID when the agent places outgoing calls. When set to true the hunt group's caller ID will be used.

directLineCallerIdName.description: Settings for the direct line caller ID name to be shown for this hunt group.

dialByName.description: The name to be used for dial by name functions.  Characters of `%`,  `+`, `\`, `"` and Unicode characters are not allowed.
